headline: Knee-high SSE junk on a short period — log it or skip it.
today: Tiny 1.2-1.3ft at 4s from a marginal angle, so don't expect much shape. Best shot is the morning while the WNW cross-off keeps it semi-organized before the S onshore fills in for the evening. Longboard only, and even that's a stretch. Honestly a coffee-and-check day.

daysToWatch.note: Swell drops to 0.7-0.9ft but the period stretches to 7-10s from a good SE angle. Small but clean-ish early on cross wind — worth a dawn log before the afternoon SSW cross-on messes it up.

Size finally shows: 2.2-3ft with morning and afternoon offshore N winds. It's a marginal S angle so it'll be more of a beachbreak scramble than a peeler, but it's the day with actual waves. Shortboard or groveler.
